provenance.dimension_basis: manufacturer family envelope; exact video variant uncertain
provenance.hidden_structure: hinge and latch internal dimensions inferred; no OEM service geometry asserted

review.frame_coverage: 2311 retained source frames in29 segments. Both compressed videos fully decode to2311 frames at the source frame rate.
review.visual_review: All18 encoded start/middle/end comparison boards and all32 additional encoded mechanical/camera frames on seven final_motion_review boards inspected. Four closures, drop-down opening, shelf extraction, filter removal/held cleaning/reinsertion, and interior macro camera checked.
review.revision: Nativev093 keeps the drop-down door, two-link stays, removable shelf and left filter as separate moving parts. Two missed closures614-638 and1354-1370 restored. Closed-door macro camera separated from moving-door features. Inferred stay mounting and lengths revised to avoid excessive folding height.
review.mechanics: Visible door and removable-part states are source-frame observations with interpolation through blur/occlusion. Stay hidden attachment height and link lengths are engineering assumptions. Repeated cut-to-closed/open states do not invent unseen transitions. No knob rotation was observed or added.
review.geometry: Five cabinet/assembly checks pass. Structural door surfaces clear at11 sampled angles; stays clear tested surfaces at10 angles; shelf/filter clear tested housing at19 sampled poses. Hinge engagement, pins and guides are excluded. These diagnostics do not establish continuous collision freedom or physical performance.
review.alignment_limit: Not pixel-perfect. Close-door macro depth is weakly constrained and interpolated during1352-1370. Blurred rapid door motion has residual edge and angle differences; shelf/filter poses under hands are inferred. Gloss, glazing, wall pressings, small labels, depth of field and editorial overlays differ. People, food and filming environment are outside scope.
review.scene: Frozen Tangyuan kitchen and shared external lighting, with visually estimated internal lamps and observed display states.
